title: Reconciliation-ledger integrity
supported_claim: On the tested same-host prototype, a dedicated HMAC-authenticated reconciliation checkpoint over the canonical reconciliation ledger, together with a trusted minimum reconciliation-checkpoint generation, detected the preregistered PENDING-to-SETTLED forgery, SETTLED-to-PENDING rollback, row deletion, pre/post ledger-digest substitution, checkpoint-generation lowering or inflation, permit/token nonce substitution, settlement-checkpoint-digest substitution, coherent full-row rewrite, stale/current reconciliation-state and checkpoint substitutions, forged checkpoint, scope/predecessor tampering, and repeated-restart tampered bundles. The clean higher-generation SETTLED reconciliation checkpoint remained live.
not_proven: Atomic commitment or cryptographic consistency between the separate permit-ledger and reconciliation-ledger integrity roots
Atomic commitment between SQLite and a truly external checkpoint service
Protection after compromise of SQLite together with the reconciliation-integrity key or trusted-minimum authority
next_falsification_target: EXP-I Pilot 7: composite cross-root consistency. Bind the current permit-ledger digest and reconciliation-ledger digest under one platform checkpoint so independently valid but mixed-era roots cannot be combined into a false current state.
